headline: Keep grammatical quoted noun modifiers inside their sentence

items.title: Recognize quoted questions used as determined noun modifiers
items.insight: Valid published prose passes the copy gate while genuine lowercase sentence defects remain rejected. Recognize only matching question quotations used immediately after a determiner and followed by part plus a full stop, with horizontal spacing. Retain true lowercase sentence, later-sentence, paragraph and mismatched-quote rejection. Add positive and negative native regressions before parser implementation, preserve existing tests and published prose.
items.evidence: docs/S411_copy-noun-findings-1108.json; actual native corpus failure and independent fixture before implementation.
